schema.description:
Endorsement policy:  
- OR ('aaaaaa1MSP.peer','aaaaaa2MSP.peer',...) indicates that endorsement from any one organization in the channel is sufficient.  
- AND ('aaaaaa1MSP.peer','aaaaaa2MSP.peer',...) indicates that endorsement from all organizations in the channel is required.  
- OutOf(a,'aaaaaa1MSP.peer','aaaaaa2MSP.peer',...): when a is 1, endorsement from any one organization in the channel is sufficient; when a is 2, endorsement from at least two organizations in the channel is required; when a equals the total number of organizations, the endorsement requirement is equivalent to AND.
